scenario.topic: Choose a cloud provider for hosting our web app
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to us when picking a cloud provider: cost, reliability, or ease of use?

options.name: Amazon Web Services EC2 Instances
options.upside: Highly scalable with extensive global infrastructure
options.tradeoff: Complex pricing can lead to unexpected costs
options.concern: Steep learning curve for new users

options.name: Google Cloud Platform App Engine
options.concern: May limit customization for complex apps
options.best_for: teams valuing ease of deployment and scaling

options.name: Microsoft Azure Virtual Machines
options.upside: Strong integration with Microsoft tools and services
options.concern: Support can be slower compared to premium tiers

options.name: DigitalOcean Droplets Standard Plan
options.upside: Simpler pricing and easy setup for smaller apps
options.concern: May not handle sudden traffic spikes well

shared_context: The team has exactly 3 members deciding together
We need to host a web app with moderate traffic expected
Our budget allows up to $2000 per month for hosting
We want a provider with good support and uptime guarantees

personas.name: Emeka
personas.background: As a highly open and extraverted team member, I value simplicity and cost-effectiveness for smaller apps to enable quick iteration.
personas.private_goal: I want a cloud provider that offers easy setup and predictable pricing to avoid surprises and speed up deployment.

ask about a practical constraint that could affect the choice
compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative
look for a workable compromise the group could accept

personas.name: Jasper
personas.background: I am cautious and somewhat anxious about unexpected costs and complexity, preferring a balance between ease of use and control.
personas.private_goal: I want a provider that simplifies deployment with automatic scaling but still offers reasonable cost predictability.

compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative

Options:

B) Google Cloud Platform App Engine — monthly cost: $1500; uptime guarantee: 99.95%; scalability: Automatic scaling (+ Simplifies deployment with automatic scaling; − Less control over underlying infrastructure)
C) Microsoft Azure Virtual Machines — monthly cost: $1700; uptime guarantee: 99.95%; scalability: Moderate (+ Strong integration with Microsoft tools and services; − Scaling requires manual configuration)
D) DigitalOcean Droplets Standard Plan — monthly cost: $1200; uptime guarantee: 99.9%; scalability: Basic vertical scaling (+ Simpler pricing and easy setup for smaller apps; − Less global data center coverage)
